title: Volume is the tell
summary: A big move on thin volume and a big move on heavy volume mean very different things.

cards.headline: Volume is the tell
cards.body: A price move on heavy volume means many people acted on it. The same move on light volume is a few traders and a thin tape. Volume doesn't predict direction; it measures conviction. A breakout almost nobody trades rarely holds.

cards.headline: Conviction, not direction
cards.body: Rising price on rising volume shows buyers are committed. Rising price on falling volume can be a move running out of fuel. You aren't reading where price goes next. You're reading how much the crowd believes the move so far.

cards.title: The takeaway
cards.summary: Volume measures the conviction behind a move, not its direction.
bullets: Big move, big volume: the crowd is committed.
Big move, thin volume: fewer believers, weaker signal.
Read volume beside price, never on its own.
